column2: Oaxaca-Blinder residual "often interpreted as an upper bound on discrimination"
column5: Residual is biased upward by omitted productivity variables but downward when controls (e.g. occupation) are themselves shaped by discrimination; the file's own misconception bullet says this, so "upper bound" is inconsistent (standard treatment, e.g. Blau and Kahn 2017 JEL)
column6: Explainer: now "often read as a rough measure of discrimination, which can overstate or understate it"
